summary: Keplr wallet paused Google/Apple logins after Web3Auth breach drained >=$6M from social-login accounts across Cosmos chains incl. Injective. Wallet-provider exploit, not an Injective protocol bug, but negative headline for the ecosystem. Price -4% 24h.
catalyst_note: 2026-11-07 Keplr/Web3Auth social-login exploit, >=$6M drained across Cosmos chains incl. Injective
